title: 第7章 异世界的情况第8章 疯狂的专家们
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: 林默躺在柔软的床上，盯着惨白的天花板，脑子里乱成一锅粥。
没压力是假的。
要是穿越失败，自己的下场想都不敢想。
他闭上眼，在胡思乱想中，意识渐渐沉沦。
“老天保佑...”
这是他坠入深沉梦乡前的最后一个念头。
一股浓烈的血腥味和草药味混杂着钻入鼻腔。
林默猛地睁开眼，发现自己正躺在一张简陋的木板床上。
周围是连绵不绝的呻吟声和压抑的哭泣声。
这里是精灵防线后方的一处临时伤兵营，巨大的树冠下，躺满了受伤的精灵战士。
断手断脚都是小场面，有的被黑色的魔气侵蚀，皮肤溃烂，痛苦地扭动着身体。
那画面，寻常人真的看不到，毕竟正常短视频都打码。
林默看的心中一紧，叹了口气，这就是战争。
不是游戏，没有马赛克。
他强忍着胃里翻江倒海的不适感，从床上爬起来。
他松了口气，开始四处寻找芬朵娜的身影。
很快，他就在一群伤患中找到了她。
只见她面色凝重地蹲在一位胸口塌陷的精灵面前，手掌上绽放着柔和的微光。
“嗯？魔法治疗？”林默看得若有所思，
他快步走了过去，
“芬朵娜殿下！”
芬朵娜抬起头，看到是林默，脸上挤出一丝疲惫的笑容，
“你醒了？身体没事吧？”
“我没事，就是被砸晕了。”林默摆了摆手，象征性地问问，
“需要帮忙吗？”
他本以为会得到一句“不用了你好好休息”之类的客套话。
谁知芬朵娜眼睛一亮，
“啊？那太谢谢了！”
“那边缺人帮忙搬运伤员，你去搭把手吧，之前你潜入我寝宫的事，我就当无事发生。”
不是，这事过不去了是吧？
怎么感觉自己像个被抓住把柄的受？
脑补芬朵娜：人类，你也不想闯入我寝宫睡我腿上的事被说出去吧？
content_en:
Lin Mo lay on the soft bed, staring at the pale ceiling, his mind a mess.
The lack of pressure is a lie.
If the time travel fails, I can't even think about my fate.
He closed his eyes, and in his random thoughts, his consciousness gradually sank.
"God bless..."
This was his last thought before falling into a deep sleep.
...
A strong smell of blood and herbs penetrated the nose.
Lin Mo opened his eyes suddenly and found that he was lying on a simple wooden bed.
There were continuous moans and suppressed cries all around.
This is a temporary wounded soldier camp behind the elven defense line. Under the huge canopy, there are injured elven warriors lying there.
The severed hands and feet were all small scenes, some were eroded by black evil energy, the skin was ulcerated, and the body was twisting in pain.
Ordinary people really can't see that picture, after all, normal short videos are coded.
Lin Mo's heart tightened when he saw it, and he sighed, this is war.
Not a game, no mosaic.
He endured the discomfort in his stomach and got up from the bed.
He breathed a sigh of relief and began to look around for Fendona.
Soon, he found her among a group of injured patients.
She was seen squatting in front of an elf with a collapsed chest with a solemn expression, and a soft shimmer bloomed on her palms.
"Huh? Magical treatment?" Lin Mo looked thoughtfully,
He walked over quickly,
"Your Highness Fenduona!"
Fenduona raised her head and saw Lin Mo, with a tired smile on her face.
"Are you awake? Are you okay?"
"I'm fine, I just got knocked unconscious." Lin Mo waved his hand and asked symbolically,
"Need help?"
He expected to get a polite word like "No need, take a good rest".
Unexpectedly, Fenduona's eyes lit up.
"Huh? Thank you so much!"
"There is a shortage of people over there to help carry the wounded, so go and help. I will just pretend that nothing happened when you sneaked into my bedroom before."
Lin Mo: "..."
No, this matter can't be overcome, right?
Why do you feel like you've been caught?
Brainstorming Fenduona: Human being, you don’t want to be told about breaking into my bedroom and sleeping on my lap, right?
